mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_week_result_data WHERE game_result = 'clear' AND user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND DATE(ins_date) = CURDATE()), 0) AS game_clear_count_day, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_login_log WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND DATE(ins_date) = CURDATE()), 0) AS user_login_count, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM epic_skill_upgrade_log WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND DATE(ins_date) = CURDATE()), 0) AS epic_skill_upgrade_count, IFNULL(SUM(ar_upgrade_count + shotgun_upgrade_count + sniping_upgrade_count), 0) AS unit_upgrade_count, IFNULL(SUM(drawing_count), 0) AS drawing_count, IFNULL(SUM(result_kill_zombie), 0) AS result_kill_zombie, IFNULL(SUM(epic_skill_1_count + epic_skill_2_count), 0) AS epic_skill_count, IFNULL(SUM(use_goods), 0) AS use_goods, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quest_log WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND quest_day_type = 'day' AND DATE(ins_date) = CURDATE()), 0) AS day_quest FROM game_week_result_data WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND DATE(ins_date) = CURDATE() AND game_result IN ('clear', 'Failed');

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_week_result_data WHERE game_result = 'clear' AND user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND DATE(ins_date) BETWEEN (SELECT ADDDATE(CURDATE(), - WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 0 )) AND (SELECT ADDDATE(CURDATE(), - WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 6 ))), 0) AS game_clear_count_week, COALESCE(SUM(result_kill_zombie), 0) AS result_kill_zombie_week, COALESCE(SUM(shotgun_relics + ar_relics + sniping_relics), 0) AS unit_relics_count, COALESCE(SUM(shotgun_narrative + ar_narrative + sniping_narrative), 0) AS unit_narrative_count, COALESCE(SUM(shotgun_legend + ar_legend + sniping_legend), 0) AS unit_legend_count, COALESCE(SUM(shotgun_mythology + ar_mythology + sniping_mythology), 0) AS unit_mythology_count, COALESCE(SUM(shotgun_beginning + ar_beginning + sniping_beginning), 0) AS unit_beginning_count, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quest_log WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND quest_day_type = 'week' AND date_format(ins_date,'%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN (SELECT ADDDATE(CURDATE(), - WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 0 )) AND (SELECT ADDDATE(CURDATE(), - WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 6 ))), 0) AS week_quest FROM game_week_result_data WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND DATE(ins_date) BETWEEN (SELECT ADDDATE(CURDATE(), - WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 0 )) AND (SELECT ADDDATE(CURDATE(), - WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 6 )) AND game_result IN ('clear', 'Failed');
